```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

`ucdpR` supports reproducible research with data from the Uppsala Conflict
Data Program. It discovers current and historical releases, imports data,
retains provenance, retrieves supporting documentation, and provides tools for
validation, spatial preparation, precision assessment, and release comparison.

The usual live-data workflow is deliberately short:

```{r, eval = FALSE}
library(ucdpR)

ucdp_search("georeferenced|candidate")
ged <- ucdp_get("ged", version = "25.1", format = "csv")
ucdp_metadata(ged)
ucdp_validate(ged)
```

Specifying a version makes the analytical input explicit. Objects returned by
`ucdp_get()` retain the selected catalog record, source URL, checksum,
retrieval time, and package version in their `ucdp_source` attribute.

Most analytical helpers also work with ordinary data frames. This makes it
possible to inspect a prepared subset without another download:

```{r}
library(ucdpR)

events <- data.frame(
  id = 1:3,
  year = c(2020, 2021, 2021),
  where_prec = c(1, 2, 6),
  date_prec = c(1, 3, 5),
  latitude = c(50, 51, 52),
  longitude = c(10, 11, 12)
)

ucdp_schema(events)
ucdp_precision(events)
ucdp_filter_precision(events, where_prec = 1:2, date_prec = 1:3)
ucdp_aggregate(events, unit = "conflict-year", id = "id",
               include_fatalities = FALSE)
```

Four focused vignettes provide the detailed workflows:

* `vignette("accessing-and-versioning", package = "ucdpR")` explains catalog
  discovery, exact releases, downloads, imports, and update checks.
* `vignette("spatial-workflows", package = "ucdpR")` covers precision-aware
  conversion to `sf` and preparation for downstream spatial joins.
* `vignette("uncertainty-and-revisions", package = "ucdpR")` treats precision
  and retrospective revisions as observable dimensions of uncertainty.
* `vignette("reproducible-research", package = "ucdpR")` combines metadata,
  schemas, validation, codebooks, version histories, and replication files.

`ucdpR` is an independent community client and does not redistribute UCDP
data. Consult UCDP's documentation and citation guidance for every dataset and
report the exact data version used in published work.
